Title: [tune] how to enforce even integer number in the search space

I also tried `tune.sample_from(lambda spec: np.random.randint(2, 64) * 2)`, and HyperOpt gave error:

> HyperOpt does not support parameters of type `Function` with samplers of type `NoneType`
